blocks.title: Business Developer, Market Intelligence Team (Customer Survey + Market Demand Analysis)
bullets: Identified an opportunity for hands-free cooking support and conceived an AI-powered refrigerator service that saves recipes from personal collections & guides users through cooking via voice. Defined the concept, scope, and business model. Directed software engineers to execute.

Analyzed global appliance market trends (market size, pricing, market share, B2B/B2C, etc.) across 12 regions and 8 product categories using GfK, Euromonitor, and BSRIA data, and produced 5-year demand forecasts through 2030, informing company-wide/regional strategy.

Built an enterprise demand-intelligence dashboard and AI assistant, consolidating market, regional, and sales data into on-demand analyses and executive summaries for product management and sales teams; presented to VP-level leadership and now deployed company-wide and in active use.

blocks.title: Data-driven UX Researcher & Service/Experience Designer
blocks.sub: SDI Lab | Data-Driven Service Design Business Strategy Consulting Institute (SKKU)
bullets: Conducted qualitative research including home-visit interviews, co-creation workshops, and persona interviews with people with disabilities, hospital patients, ministry staff, and mall visitors to uncover user needs.

Analyzed behavioral data from social media, card transactions, and online communities using network analysis, clustering, process mining, and heatmaps to derive customer personas and journey patterns.
Translated research findings into journey maps, service blueprints, and strategies for clients in retail, healthcare, and the public sector.
Led disability research using Generative Agent simulation to automate service-needs assessment across 5 data-driven persona clusters.

blocks.title: First Lieutenant, Headquarters Battery Commander
bullets: Led 60+ soldiers across six functions (transportation/ammunition/communications/medical/operations/intelligence). Built a 3D terrain model to train soldiers on enemy infiltration routes, defending the battalion command post in a war-game against a tank assault and 15 raids.
President of Korea ROTC 60th Officer Corps (3,561 alumni) — arranged 10 hospital partnerships & a job fair with Shinhan Financial Group.

blocks.title: Research Analyst
bullets: Analyzed manufacturing process, core-component supply chain, and regional regulations (e.g., ISO) to assess market-entry feasibility.
Developed market-entry strategy scenarios based on the market analysis, including M&A target recommendations.

blocks.title: VIP Concierge Robot Service Design, SKKU President’s Office
bullets: Owned experience design for VIP reception robot service, interviewing secretarial staff, the president, and VIP visitors to translate their wants into an end-to-end experience blending the university's royal-court heritage with its technology.

Designed 3 coordinated robot personas for welcome, tour, and refreshment, grounded in royal court protocol and the office’s existing greeting workflow; visualized them in service blueprints and directed mechanical engineering students on the build; the robots now operate.

blocks.title: Aging with Disability Product/Service Design, National Rehabilitation Center
bullets: Co-designed and conducted home-visit interviews with 9 people with spinal cord injury, developmental disabilities, or stroke.
Synthesized findings into daily-living journey maps for each group that surfaced unmet needs and aging-related challenges.

Directed a 40-student design hackathon to develop real products/services based on research; guided students to use the journey maps to identify opportunity areas and prototype 9 rehabilitation product/service concepts, which the center evaluated and awarded.

blocks.title: Inpatient Rehabilitation Service Design, Samsung Hospital (SAIHST)
bullets: Co-designed gamified rehabilitation programs (step-count levels, meal-pickup and exercise missions) and the UI/UX of a hospital app to promote patient rehabilitation, grounded in interviews and surveys with long-term hospitalized patients.

Conceived and prototyped in Unity and Magma a collaborative artwork service where patients find tags around the hospital like a treasure hunt, collect puzzle pieces, and combine them into a shared artwork displayed in public hospital spaces.

blocks.title: Data-driven Disability Persona Augmentation for Service Journey Inference
bullets: Developed a computational framework for studying disability service needs where experiments and data are hard to obtain.

Augmented Vineland-adaptive behavior data from 9 individuals with developmental disabilities to 2,400 cases; derived 5 persona clusters and ran AI-driven daily life scenario (ADL/IADL) simulations that compute support-need levels and causes, visualized as a journey map.
